edits.old: And no result and no decision record are written

And no result and no decision record are written

  Scenario: AC6 The business rules of section 8 are asserted and changed by none (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rules BR1 to BR8 of section 8 are in force in RWB-S9-E7013-APP
    When the review is run for the partner
    Then each of BR1 to BR8 is asserted as stated in section 8
    And the harness sets or changes none of BR1 to BR8

  Scenario: AC7 A consumed call that fails or does not answer stops the review (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the partner read or the instruction read fails or does not answer within the 2 s budget of BR8
    When the review is run for the partner
    Then the run fails at that hop and the report names the service, the operation and the contract version
    And no result is recorded against the instruction and no decision record is written
